^That note sounds just like the red bar on the xylophone!

b: ^I've got Ms. Willow's chime mallet back!
^A little wooden mallet. Whose could it be?

again: ^The bluebird hums along to nothing in particular, very softly.

b: ^ The rainbow xylophone! But there's no mallet to play it with.

next: ^Hmm. That doesn't sound like the class song.

b: ^ Maybe Ms. Willow knows how it goes.
^ Maybe that bluebird knows the last note.

song: ^That's it! That's our class song! Bravo, Fae!
^You found the note the scribbles hid. Now come here, I have something for you.
^This was my very first flute, when I was just about your age.
^Ms. Willow gives Fae a little wooden flute, painted with flowers and pastel bands.
^Play it, and animal friends will come running to listen.
^Out to the playing field with you. Coach Ash props the gym's back door open at recess.

piano: ^An upright piano, polished till it shines. Ms. Willow plays the class song on it.
song_poster: ^Our class song, in big coloured dots... scribbled all over with purple marker!
^The same purple as the Star Racer scribbles.

b: ^ The last note is completely hidden.

music_window: ^The window's wide open. That's how the kid in the purple hood got in, and out again.
^A few purple fuzzies are caught on the latch.
instrument_shelf: ^Tambourines, maracas, a drum, and a triangle. Everything a band needs!
oak_squirrel_calm: ^That big branch is my favourite spot. This morning a kid in a purple hood swung on it, right across the creek!
^They whooped all the way over. Then, fizz! I had to throw something at everybody.
^Swing across the creek on that branch... with Coach Ash's lasso!

again: ^The squirrel hugs an acorn and keeps very, very still.

b: ^ A fizzy squirrel is pelting acorns from the big branch! Nobody's getting near it like that.
^ The old oak's branch reaches right across the creek. If only I had a rope...

oak_branch: ^The old oak's branch reaches right across the creek.
^Fae twirls Coach Ash's lasso, loops it over the branch, and gives it a good tug.

again: ^Wheee! Fae swings across the creek again.

hood_stash: ^A purple backpack, tucked behind the old stump!
^Purple markers... a bottle of fizzy purple soda... and a Star Racer token.
^It's the hooded kid's stash! So this is where they ran at PE.
^Was that a purple hood, way down the path? ...Gone again.

again: ^The hooded kid's purple backpack. They haven't come back for it... yet.

b: ^ The lever's down, and the old footbridge is across the creek.

bridge_lever: ^A lever, way up on the old footbridge's post.

b: ^ It's much too high to reach!

bridge_lever: ^Too high to reach... but not for a lasso!
^Fae loops the lasso over the lever's handle and pulls with all her might.
^CLUNK! Creeeak... The old footbridge swings down across the creek!
^Now there's a way back across. Thanks, Coach Ash!
mist_closed: ^A little dirt path winds off between the misty trees. Something purple is tucked beside the old stump.
mist_flowers: ^The bluebells glow in a little line toward the lavender mist.
^They are showing stepping stones! I can hop across, one stone at a time.
^Fae hops across the mist, stone by stone.

again: ^The bluebells still glow along the safe path through the mist.

b: ^ The stepping stones are glowing in the mist. I can follow them now!
^The lavender mist is too thick to see through. Maybe something can show me the way.
^ The old rope bridge is pulled across the gully now.

gully_bridge: ^The gully is deep and misty, with two little posts on this side.

b: ^ The far posts have a rolled-up bridge. If only I had a rope!

gully_bridge: ^Fae loops her lasso over the far post and pulls.
^The old rope bridge rolls across the gully with a soft creak. Now there is a way through!

b: ^ The forest glows warmly beyond the bell-flower arch.
^ Three bell flowers hum softly: red, yellow-green, and blue. Some notes are missing... what song are they waiting for?

mist_seal: ^The bell flowers are waiting for a tune. The class song colours might help!

mist_green: ^Fae plays a green note. No bell answers.

b: ^That's it! Red, yellow, blue, red! The bell flowers ring together.
^The mist wall parts, and a warm forest glow shines through the arch.
^The bells give a gentle wobble. They only ring for a song I already know...

hopscotch: ^Fae hops the whole hopscotch on one foot, all the way to 7 and back!
tetherball: ^Fae gives the tetherball a whack. Round and round it goes!

b: ^ Mom's microwave is up on top. With a box from her freezer, I can cook!

club_fridge: ^An old fridge with its door hanging open. Inside, it's as warm as toast.
^Leave it to me! I keep the cooler on my dad's boat running.
^Sue wiggles the plug, gives the door a bump with her hip, and...
^Hummmm! The door clicks shut, the old fridge shivers, and a cool glow comes on.
^Ta-da! Cold and humming. Now the club needs something to keep in it.

b: ^ The fridge hums away, nice and cold. It's empty.
^ The fridge hums away, nice and cold. Strawberries from the deck will keep in here.

stocked: ^The fridge is full of cold strawberries from the deck!
cook: ^Mom's microwave is up on top of the fridge, ready to go!
take: ^Fae packs three strawberry snacks into her backpack.
^Snacks for the road! Critters love strawberries.

club_ladder: ^A ladder up to somebody's secret clubhouse. It smells like purple fizzy soda up there.
^It isn't ours to climb into... yet.
club_comics: ^A stack of comics about a superhero cat. Somebody read them over and over: the corners are all soft.
club_bottles: ^Empty bottles of fizzy purple soda, left behind by the kid in the purple hood.
club_garden: ^Long wooden planter boxes, full of soil, with nothing growing.
^Perfect! I saved strawberry seeds all the way from the pass.
^Jordan pokes the seeds into the soil, one by one, and marks each row with a stick.
^My grandma says a garden grows best when everything around it is calm.
^Then let's calm some critters! Every one we calm, the garden will grow a little.

planted: ^The seeds are tucked in. Calm a critter, and they'll sprout!
growing: ^Little green leaves, and tiny white flowers!

b: ^ Two more calm critters, and there'll be strawberries.
^ One more calm critter, and there'll be strawberries!
^ The fridge isn't working yet. Let's ask Sue to fix it, so they stay fresh!

ripe: ^Fae and Jordan fill a whole basket, and tuck it into the fridge.
^The plants are still growing. Two more calm critters, and there'll be more!

flute: ^Fae plays a little tune on her painted flute.

c-0: ^Woof! Woof! The Pond Pup comes running!
c-1: ^Good boy! The Pond Pup trots off home, wagging.
c-2: ^Chitter-chitter! The Acorn Squirrel scampers down a tree and hops along!
c-3: ^Off you go! The Acorn Squirrel bounds away, his tail bouncing.

nobody: ^Nobody comes... yet. Animal friends come running, Ms. Willow said. I need to make one first!

pond: ^The pond is cool and clear. Something glints at the bottom, out past the middle rock.

b: ^ It's too far to reach, and too cold to wade in.

c-0: ^Splash! The Pond Pup paddles out past the rock and dives.
^He swims back with an old tin in his mouth. Inside: twelve shiny coins, and a note that says "For whoever finds this!"
^Good boy! Pond Pups really can swim.

after: ^The pond is cool and clear. Nothing glints at the bottom now.

tower: ^The play tower, with its patched flag flapping on top.

kite: ^A kite is caught on top of the play tower, hanging down the wall!

c-0: ^Fae twirls the lasso once, twice... and loops it right over the kite's string.
^A gentle tug, and the kite flutters down into Fae's arms.
^There's a name on the crossbar, in green marker: ROSIE. Rosie from my class!
^I'll take it back to her at school.

dock_end: ^The end of Sue's dock. The water sparkles all the way to the sky.

bottle: ^A bottle is bobbing in the water past the end of the dock! There's a rolled-up paper inside.

c-0: ^Fae loops the lasso around the bottle's neck and reels it in, hand over hand.
^She pulls out the cork. The paper is an old treasure map!
^Two palm trees, a big log, and an X right between them. That's the beach, by the big driftwood log!

b: ^ The sand between the palms is all smoothed back over.
^ Two palm trees lean together beside the big driftwood log.

dig: ^X marks the spot: right here, between the two palms!

c-0: ^Fae borrows a spade from the beach toys and digs, and digs...
^Clunk! A little tin chest, full of shiny gold coins!
^Real pirate treasure! Wait till I tell Sue.

ski_lift: ^The ski lift creaks along its cable, the empty chairs swinging.

scarf: ^A long red scarf is caught on the pink lift chair, flapping in the wind.

c-0: ^Fae aims, throws... and the lasso loops right over the dangling scarf.
^One tug, and the scarf slips free. It's soft and warm, and it smells like cocoa.

club_chest: ^Fae lifts the lid of the old toy chest. Everything she's found on her adventures is in here!

b: ^ The purple thread from the Pond Pup's tennis ball. It came from a purple hood!

club_chest: ^The note from under the comics: "NEXT STOP: THE ARCADE. FIZZ THE HIGH SCORES!"

b: ^ The purple marker the hooded kid dropped at school.
^ The Star Racer token from the hooded kid's stash. I'll give it back when I find them!
^ The old tin the Pond Pup fetched out of the park pond.
^ The treasure map from the bottle by Sue's dock. X marked the spot!
^ A bow from the tail of Rosie's kite. She gave it to me for getting it down!
^ The golden acorn from the knothole in the big oak. The Acorn Squirrel found it!

drawings: ^Drawings pinned to the wall: a kid with a big smile, and hearts and flowers.

lodge_keeper: ^Oh my stars... what happened? My head was all fizzy, like a shaken-up soda!
^My hamster Biscuit ran off this morning. While I was out looking for him, a kid in a purple hood gave me a fizzy purple soda.
^One sip, and I didn't want ANYONE in my lodge. I'm so sorry about the snowballs, dears!
^Biscuit came home all by himself, calm as can be. Somebody must have been kind to him.
^Then come in, come in, all of you! Warm up by the fire.

again: ^Mrs. Flurry sweeps the snow off her porch. "The fire's lit, dears. Come in and warm up!"

lodge_fire: ^The fire crackles and pops. Fae holds her hands out to it. Toasty!
^Now THIS is how you warm up after a snowball fight.
lodge_cocoa: ^A big copper pot of cocoa, with little marshmallows bobbing on top.
^A note on the lid says: "Help yourselves, dears! Mrs. F."
^Fae pours a mug of cocoa to take along.

again: ^The cocoa pot is still warm. Mmm, marshmallows.

lodge_guestbook: ^The lodge's guestbook, full of happy skiers' names.
^On today's page, somebody signed in purple marker, then scribbled their name out.
^There's a little paper plane doodled in the corner.

b: ^ The same purple as the marker the hooded kid dropped at school...

lodge_hamster: ^A little wooden house by the fire. Inside, a round hamster is curled up fast asleep.
^That must be Biscuit! He's snoring tiny squeaks.
mystic_pond: ^The Mystic Pond is fizzing purple, just like the clubhouse soda.

b: ^ This is where wishes come true. The fairies said someone drank from it after making a wish.

ancient_tree: ^Purple scribbles are all over the Ancient Tree's bark.

b: ^ If it's dreaming the whole land, it can't dream properly with all this fizz.

fairy_lavender: ^This is the Enchanted Forest. The Ancient Tree dreams the whole land.
^The Mystic Pond grants wishes. A kid in a purple hood made a wish and drank from it.
^Then everything went fizzy and purple, with scribbles everywhere. The Ancient Tree can't dream properly with all that fizz!
fairy_mint: ^The butterflies keep tickling my wings. I keep telling them, "Again!"
fairy_sky: ^The Ancient Tree is older than every tree, even the trees that think they are very old.
fairy_peach: ^Hee hee! The pond bubbles made my shoes go squeak.
milo_calm: ^Fae... it's me. I'm really sorry about all the scribbles.
^My paper plane flew into the mist, so I followed it. I found this forest and wished at the Mystic Pond to be the best at everything, even Star Racer.
^I drank from the pond, and the fizz got out of hand. Fizz-fast, I could zip from our classroom to the hall and back before anyone noticed. That's how I peeked in, then sat back down.
^I always notice you, Milo. You're my friend.

b: ^ Sue gives Milo a small wave. "We noticed you too."
^ Jordan smiles. "You don't have to be the best at everything."

again: ^The Ancient Tree is glowing again. It's so pretty now.

c-1: ^Not yet. We can stay here a little longer.

oak_knothole: ^High up the big oak, there's a dark knothole. Something rattles inside it when the wind blows.

b: ^ It's much too high to climb, and too small for my hand.
^ My lasso can't get inside a hole, either.

c-0: ^Chitter! The Acorn Squirrel zips up the trunk and pops into the knothole.
^He scampers back down with a golden acorn, and a whole pile of hazelnuts!
^A golden acorn! It shines like a little sun.
